Penalty_PerkCrafter_HigherFoodConsumptio: Villagers have a {0} higher chance of consuming double the food during a break.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_HigherServicesConsum: Villagers have a {0} higher chance of consuming double the service goods.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_LessResolveFromShelt: The need for basic housing grants {0} less Resolve.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_LongerCystBurning_De: Burning a cyst takes {0} seconds longer.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_MoreHostilityForGlad: Discovered Dangerous Glades add {0} more Hostility (retroactive).
Penalty_PerkCrafter_NegativeSeasonalEffe: Negative Forest Mysteries require a lower Hostility level ({0}) to activate during the Storm.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_SacrificeCost_Desc: Resources sacrificed in the Hearth burn {0} quicker.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_SacrificeStacks_Desc: -{0} to sacrifice stacks in the Ancient Hearth.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_TotemOnDeath_Desc: Dying villagers leave behind small Fishmen Totems.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_TraderMerchMoreExpen: Perks and blueprints sold by traders are {0} more expensive.
Penalty_PerkCrafter_TradeRouteFuel_Desc: Travel cost of trade routes is increased by {0}.
Perk_FiberForVegetables_Desc: Handy tools for cutting stems and leaves. Gain {0} for every {1} produced.
Perk_FuelConsumption25Slower_Desc: An old manuscript detailing long-forgotten burning rites. Fuel consumption in Hearths is decreased by {0}.
Perk_FuelConsumption25SlowerAltar_Desc: An old manuscript detailing long-forgotten burning rites. Fuel consumption in Hearths is decreased by {0}. {1}
Perk_FuelConsumptionSlowerGeneric_Desc: Fuel consumption in Hearths is decreased by {0}.
Perk_MoreChargesForNodes_Desc: Newly discovered gathering nodes have more charges: +{0} for small ones, and +{1} for large ones.
Perk_MoreNewcommers_Desc: Each newcomer group has {0} additional villagers.
Perk_NewcomersForGlades_Desc: Gain one villager every time you discover a new glade.
Perk_NoImpatienceForDeath_Daily_Desc: Suspiciously little news from your settlement reaches the Citadel. Impatience doesn't grow when villagers leave or die.
Perk_NoImpatienceForDeath_Desc: The crown doesn't need to know everything. Impatience doesn't grow when villagers leave or die.
Perk_NoImpatienceForDeath_WIthDrawback_D: The crown doesn't need to know everything. There is no Impatience penalty when villagers leave or die, but Impatience will grow {0} faster, starting from Drizzle year {1}.
Perk_NoProductionChance_Distracted_Desc: Villagers with this effect have a {0} chance of destroying the yield with each production cycle.
Perk_ProductionButDeathChance_Desc: Results matter more than your villagers’ health. Increases global production speed by {0}, but villagers have a {1} chance of dying every 120 seconds.
Perk_ToolsForDeath_Desc: Gain {0} every time a villager leaves or dies.
Perk_TradePackRecipe_Desc: <sprite name="[packs] pack of trade goods"> packs of trade goods ({0}) can be produced at the Makeshift Post.
Perk_VillagerBreakTime_Stagnant_Desc: Villagers with this effect take {0} longer breaks.
Perk_VillagerDeathChance_Danger_Desc: Homeless villagers have a {1} chance of dying every {0} seconds during the storm.
Perk_VillagerDeathChance_Energized_Desc: Villagers with this effect move {0} faster.
Perk_VillagerDeathChance_Sick_Desc: Villagers with this effect have a {1} chance of perishing every {0} seconds.
Perk_VillagerExtraConsumption_Gluttonous: Villagers with this effect have a {0} chance of consuming double the amount of food during a break.
Perk_VillagerExtraProduction_Focused_Des: Villagers with this effect have a {0} chance of doubling the yield with each production cycle.
Perk_VillagerNeedIntervalRate_Stagnant_D: Time between breaks is reduced by {0} for villagers with this effect.
Perk_VillagerSpeed_Exhausted_Desc: Villagers with this effect move {0} slower.
Prefix_UntilNextStorm: (the penalty will last until the next storm season)
Race_Bat_Description: A stern and fiercely devoted people, they take pride in enduring what breaks others and cannot stand being favored. Bats excel at metallurgy (<sprite name="metallurgy">) but find no particular comfort in any type of work.
Race_Bat_Description_Short: A stern and fiercely devoted people, they take pride in enduring what breaks others and cannot stand being favored.
Race_Bat_Passive_Desc_Long:
Gain one stack of Dedication (+1 Bat Resolve) for every 2 members of other species who leave or die. One stack of this effect is removed when a Bat leaves or dies.
Bats can't be favored.
Race_Bat_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Grants the Manorial Court blueprint. This building allows you to banish members of a chosen species to boost the global chance of producing double yields.
Race_Beaver_Description: Beavers are hardworking and honest, but also quite demanding. They are gifted woodworkers (<sprite name="wood">) and enjoy engineering (<sprite name="tech">). Beavers are also known for their innate talent for salesmanship.
Race_Beaver_Description_Short: Beavers are hardworking and honest, but also quite demanding. They excel at woodworking and have an innate talent for salesmanship.
Race_Beaver_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Each neighboring town offers one additional Trade Route option.
Race_Fox_Description: Majestic and mysterious creatures, deeply connected to the forest. They have developed a symbiosis with Blightrot through their long exposure to rainwater. Foxes are skilled scouts (<sprite name="foxforest">) and feel comfortable cooperating with their own kind (<sprite name="cooperation">). They are highly susceptible to starvation, yet are immune to Hostility.
Race_Fox_Description_Short: Majestic and mysterious creatures, deeply connected to the forest. They have developed a symbiosis with Blightrot through their long exposure to rainwater. They are very susceptible to starvation.
Race_Fox_Passive_Desc_Long: Hostility of the Forest does not lower Foxes' Resolve.
Race_Fox_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Reveals the location of a Rainwater Geyser in a nearby undiscovered glade.
Race_Frog_Description: A dignified and proud people with a unique affinity for wealth, renowned for their exceptional skills in architecture and their love of water. Shelters do not satisfy them - they require pools of water to feel truly at home. Frogs are skilled masons (<sprite name="stone">) and love working with rainwater (<sprite name="rainwater">).
Race_Frog_Description_Short: A dignified and proud people with a unique affinity for wealth, renowned for their exceptional skills in architecture and their love of water. Shelters do not satisfy them - they require pools of water to feel truly at home.
Race_Frog_Passive_Desc_Long: Frogs don't have a Basic Housing need and don't want to live in Shelters or Big Shelters. They will only move into Frog Houses.
Race_Frog_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Reveals the location of a ruin in a nearby undiscovered glade.
Race_Harpy_Description: Harpies are a noble and fragile species, with a primal, aggressive side to them. They have lost their ability to fly due to centuries of exposure to the rain. They excel at alchemy (<sprite name="alchemy">) and love to work with cloth (<sprite name="cloth">).
Race_Harpy_Description_Short: Harpies are a noble and fragile species, with a primal, aggressive side to them. They have lost their ability to fly due to centuries of exposure to the rain.
Race_Human_Description: Humans are a very adaptable species, but they are also very susceptible to the rain. They rely heavily on special clothing, such as their famous rain shells, to keep them dry. Humans are adept at farming (<sprite name="farming">) and really enjoy brewing (<sprite name="brewing">).
Race_Human_Description_Short: Humans are a very adaptable species, but they are also very susceptible to the rain. They rely heavily on special clothing, such as their famous rain shells, to keep them dry.
Race_Human_RevealEffect_Desc_Long: Reveals the location of a fertile soil patch in a nearby undiscovered glade.
Race_Lizard_Description: Lizards are a very resilient species, but their cold-blooded nature makes them more dependent on fire than any other species. They are very distrustful and religiously believe that true bonds are only forged in battle. They are very good with animals and meat production (<sprite name="meat">), and prefer to work in warm environments (<sprite name="fire">).
Race_Lizard_Description_Short: Lizards are very resilient, but their cold-blooded nature makes them more dependent on fire than any other species. They are very distrustful and religiously believe that true bonds are only forged in battle.
RecipeGrade_Fishing_Grade1_Desc: This recipe has a basic efficiency and only allows you to fish in small fishing ponds.
RecipeGrade_Fishing_Grade2_Desc: This recipe is faster and allows you to fish in large fishing ponds.
RecipeGrade_Grade0_Desc: Production uses more resources and takes more time, since this building's equipment is not designed for this task.
RecipeGrade_Grade0_Institution_Desc: This service grants only half the Resolve bonus.
RecipeGrade_Grade1_Desc: This recipe has a basic efficiency.
RecipeGrade_Grade1_Institution_Desc: This service grants the full Resolve bonus.
RecipeGrade_Grade2_Desc: This building is properly equipped for the job, reducing production costs slightly.
RecipeGrade_Grade3_Desc: Specialized equipment grants increased yields and shorter production times.
RecipeGrade_Huts_Grade0_Desc: This recipe has a low efficiency. It's slower, and gatherers will use up {0} charges with each production cycle.
RecipeGrade_Huts_Grade1_Desc: This recipe has a basic efficiency and only allows you to gather from small gathering nodes.
RecipeGrade_Huts_Grade2_Desc: This recipe is faster and allows you to gather from large gathering nodes.
Relic_AltarOfDecay_Desc: A sinister stone structure created to worship the Blightrot. Cultists have engraved the inscription: "Nothing escapes death".
Relic_AncientGate_Desc: A strange monument of cyclopean proportions. Heavy storm clouds seem to be gathering around the settlement.
Relic_AncientShrine_T1_Desc: An ominous shrine from a long forgotten era. It's dangerous, but it might hold some ancient knowledge useful to the crown.
Relic_BatBattleground_T1_Desc: A group of fallen Bat miners, their tools left where they dropped. It seems they were scouting for a new mining site when something struck them down. The sight of these bodies causes unrest among the Bat population.
Relic_BeaverBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Beaver traders. They were probably assaulted by Fishmen. Or worse... The sight causes anxiety amongst the Beaver population.
Relic_BlightBomb_Desc: A strange humming can be heard from within the ominous device. There's nothing left to do now but detonate it... and hope the results aren't catastrophic.
Relic_Blightrot_Clone_T1_Desc: (Completing a cloned event does not count as completing a Glade Event, and so does not contribute towards perks, deeds, and score).
Relic_Blightrot_T1_Desc: A deadly carrion organism that feeds on decaying matter. It spreads through contaminated rainwater and multiplies with time, becoming more and more dangerous. Blood Flowers are a source of extremely rare resources.
Relic_BlightrotCauldron_Desc: A Rainpunk Cauldron filled with a Blightrot-contaminated liquid. A moving, living fluid spreads around.
Relic_BurrialGrounds_Desc: A strange place filled with gravestones inscribed in an ancient, long forgotten language.
Relic_Camp_Desc: A destroyed camp in the wilderness. There are still survivors in the area.
Relic_Caravan_Desc: A destroyed caravan, stranded in the wilderness. There are drag marks leading deeper into the forest... What could have caused such mayhem?
Relic_Caravan_T1_Desc: A destroyed caravan was found in the newly discovered glade. There are drag marks leading deeper into the forest... What could have caused such mayhem?
Relic_Convicts_Desc: Dangerous convicts from the Smoldering City are hiding in the forest. They somehow managed to free themselves during transport. You can decide their fate - welcome them and employ them in your settlement, or send them back to the Citadel where they will be punished.
Relic_CorruptedCaravana_Desc: A large caravan abandoned in the woods, overgrown with Blightrot Cysts. They must have fed on the transported goods... or people.
Relic_FeastHall_Funeral_Desc: A grand hall built to host magnificent feasts. Constructing it will initiate the Funeral Feast event.
Relic_FishmenCave_Desc: It looks abandoned, but what if it's not? A terrible fishy smell comes from within.
Relic_FishmenLighthouse_Desc: Once upon a time, there must have been a coast and a harbor here. Now this place is haunted by Fishmen and the waters have withdrawn. An ominous light is coming from the top of the lighthouse.
Relic_FishmenOutpost_Desc: Fishmen aren't usually a threat, but they can be a real nuisance after a while.
Relic_FishmenSoothsayer_Desc: An old wandering soothsayer, teeming with magic. He does not speak, though you can hear his voice. His eyes are blank, yet you can feel his gaze. He is not afraid of death, he stands by its side.
Relic_FishmenTotem_Desc: A sinister structure made out of bones. Smells like Fishmen magic.
Relic_ForsakenCrypt_Desc: The Forsaken Crypt hides a frustrated, poor spirit. This place seems to have been plundered a long time ago.
Relic_FoxBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Fox scouts. They must have been sent to search the area to make sure it was safe... Apparently, something stood in their way. This find is causing grief among the Fox population.
Relic_FrogBattleground_T1_Desc: A group of fallen Frog architects. It seems they were in the middle of building some sort of monument. The mere sight of these bodies causes unrest among the Frog population.
Relic_FumingMachinery_Desc: Old Rainpunk machinery left unsupervised. Unstable rainwater fumes fill the area.
Relic_FuneralFeastStage1_Desc: The mourners gather in the Feast Hall as the Funerary Feast begins. Following tradition, the guests first partake in a meal, sharing stories and memories of their departed friend.
Relic_FuneralFeastStage2_Desc: After the meal, the funeral guests partake in a customary memorial rite, guiding the soul of the departed toward its journey to a new vessel.
Relic_FuneralFeastStage3_Desc: According to tradition, after the funeral feast, the family of the departed presents small gifts to the guests - tokens to help them remember the friend they have lost.
Relic_Gargoyle_Desc: A weathered stone statue that feels strangely... alive. It seems to shift ever so slightly when no one is watching.
Relic_GenericGhostChest_Converted_Desc: A mysterious chest filled with treasure. It was left behind by a restless spirit as a token of appreciation.
Relic_GenericGhostChest_T1_Desc: The spirit will reward you for fulfilling its last wish. The contents of the chest are unknown.
Relic_Ghost1_Desc: I let us down and was defeated by the Blightrot... but you can avenge me! Kill it with fire!!!
Relic_Ghost1_Name: Ghost of a Blight Fighter Captain
Relic_Ghost10_Desc: I was leading a rebellion against the Queen's tyrannical rule, but the Royal Guard found us. Carry on my legacy!
Relic_Ghost11_Desc: A long time ago, I founded a prosperous settlement. Everything was fine, until one of our scouts discovered something terrifying in the forest. Please, help restore at least a scrap of my legacy.
Relic_Ghost12_Desc: Many viceroys disregard nature. Don't make the same mistake. Be a good example to your people.
Relic_Ghost13_Desc: In these difficult times, beauty helps us forget our troubles. Decorate your village, and your villagers will thank you.
Relic_Ghost14_Desc: Humans deserve to be treated better than the others! Without us, you’d never achieve anything. If you don’t meet our basic needs, we’ll take our revenge!
Relic_Ghost15_Desc: I challenge you, viceroy! Do you consider yourself worthy of the Queen's glance? Prove it. Time is ticking.
Relic_Ghost16_Desc: I'm so sick of these Beavers! They’re the bane of this kingdom! They deserve nothing but condemnation for what they did to us. I order you to torment them - or I'll do it myself!
Relic_Ghost17_Desc: They took our homes and our crops. They desecrated our culture, and in the end, they took our lives. The time of contempt has come.
Relic_Ghost18_Desc: These fanatics should pay for their heresies! They are dangerous, wild, and unpredictable creatures. Teach these savages, once and for all.
Relic_Ghost19_Desc: We will no longer tolerate those upturned beaks roaming the settlement freely. Everyone must learn the truth about how the Harpy alchemists poisoned us to seize power!
Relic_Ghost2_Desc: I have studied the Blightrot all my life. Nobody believes me, but the cysts are essential for the ecosystem! Grow them and find out yourself!
Relic_Ghost20_Desc: Self-righteous Beavers only want to bask in the luxuries we’ve worked so hard for. Time to end this injustice!
Relic_Ghost21_Desc: Greedy Human farmers always want to keep all the crops for themselves. Those traitors hid everything from us, and pretended the crops were rotten!
Relic_Ghost22_Desc: I promised my Queen that I would cleanse this forest of all the horrors that lived here. One night, my mount got frightened by the storm, and we fell into the Fishmen's nets. My mission must be completed!
Relic_Ghost23_Desc: Spread the word about the power of the Holy Fire! Only it can save us from the storm's wrath. Gather the villagers in the chapel and pray!
Relic_Ghost24_Desc: We worked so hard, and put our lives in danger every day. If you don't let your villagers rest, I will make sure your soul never finds peace.
Relic_Ghost25_Desc: If your eyes sparkle at the sight of gold, I have an offer for you. All you have to do is prove that you are one of us, and I will give you my treasure.
Relic_Ghost26_Desc: The foundation of success is a thriving settlement. Without solid walls, you won't survive here. Create something you can be proud of.
Relic_Ghost27_Desc: The last thing I remember is lightning hitting my caravan. The settlements are still waiting for the goods they ordered. If you deliver them, I’ll see that you’re rewarded.
Relic_Ghost28_Desc: Let the fire burn in the Hearth and grow in all its strength. Sacrifice your goods, and help the villagers weather the storm!
Relic_Ghost29_Desc: Our flock has been in mourning for many years. We will never forget the war. Please, rekindle the hope in the Harpies' hearts.
Relic_Ghost3_Desc: I lived in a very prosperous settlement, but our viceroy was greedy and didn't care about the forest at all! In the end, it brought doom upon us. Refrain from greed, and calm the forest.
Relic_Ghost30_Desc: My army fought bravely against all odds. Many of us paid the ultimate price. Please, show your respect to those who survived. I'll take care of the fallen.
Relic_Ghost31_Desc: It was them! I'm sure of it! I remember their blank, blight-tainted gaze! They ambushed me in the forest! Please, avenge me!
Relic_Ghost32_Desc: How could I have gotten lost!? Something's not right here... You! You have to help me!
Relic_Ghost33_Desc: I've lived a long and prosperous life, and I've never let a business opportunity pass me by. Good deals have a nasty habit of vanishing very quickly, so seize them!
Relic_Ghost34_Desc: Hey, you! You're a viceroy, ain't you? Your bastard friends attacked me and left me to die in the woods! Prove to me you're not like them!
Relic_Ghost35_Desc: The everlasting rain is a as much a gift as it is a curse. And yet it made us stronger, more resilient. Embrace it.
Relic_Ghost36_Desc: I was a Teadoctor for years, helping my kind endure the effects of our strange illness. In the end, the disease took me. Take care of my people for me, please.
Relic_Ghost38_Desc: These hands once built sturdy homes from raw stone; now I call upon you to restore and improve them so that they may stand the test of time.
Relic_Ghost39_Desc: In life I was a philosopher and a teacher. Now, in death, I long for those days. So let me teach you - lift the spirits of your people. Nourish their minds and bodies.
Relic_Ghost4_Desc: You hear it? This ominous forest is calling to us... Withstand its fury, and I will spare your settlement.
Relic_Ghost40_Desc: In life I wandered without aim; in death I beg you to spare others the same fate. Build a sanctuary for those who have no roof over their heads.
Relic_Ghost41_Desc: Madness, they said, but genius knows no bounds! Embrace my volatile creations and make these fools tremble at the mere sight of your power!
Relic_Ghost42_Desc: They called me a tyrant for upholding order - for daring to keep the Frog scum in their place. They banished me, left me to rot, and called it justice? Hypocrites, all of them!
Relic_Ghost43_Desc: Fate has a cruel sense of humor - one day you're swinging the axe, the next you're kneeling at the executioner's block.
Relic_Ghost44_Desc: The air turned to poison, and the dark took us all… Please, stranger - don't let this happen again.
Relic_Ghost5_Desc: Those filthy little thieves are heartless! We were starving, and they just watched and laughed in our faces. It has to stop. Teach them a lesson.
Relic_Ghost6_Desc: We cherished the Flame - it enveloped us with its warmth. But suddenly... It went out. I can't remember what happened. Please - you can’t let this happen again! Let the sound of axes echo through the forest.
Relic_Ghost7_Desc: I've had enough of all these uptight do-gooders, with their pristine morals and boring attitudes. It's time to start some trouble!
Relic_Ghost8_Desc: I wish I’d stayed with my loved ones in the Citadel. Now, all I'm left with is regret. Don't follow in my footsteps. Be kind to those around you.
Relic_Ghost9_Desc: Nothing matters except the Queen. It is an honor to serve her. Show how loyal you are. Otherwise, I will have to punish you.
Relic_GhostStag_Desc: A truly rare sight - a Spectral Treasure Stag, lured to this place by the lingering anguish of mortal souls. Those who manage to find it will be rewarded with a special treasure.
Relic_GladeTrader_Hermit_Desc: The Hermit rarely visits royal settlements, and actively avoids the Crown's officials. But he seems eager to trade with you.
Relic_GladeTrader_Seer_Desc: A strange woman is observing the settlement from afar.
Relic_GladeTrader_Shaman_Desc: A mysterious and imposing figure has been spotted near the settlement. He is pulling a wagon full of herbs and ointments.
Relic_GoldStag_Desc: Its elusive nature allows it to move like a ghost through the foggy thicket. It is believed that the beast is tied to the spirit world and the Ancestors. A special treasure awaits the one who finds it.
Relic_HarmonyAltar_Desc: An old altar found in the wilds. The ancient language carved into the stone proclaims: "Light a fire at the altar to gain the blessing of the Spirit of Harmony".
Relic_HarmonyAltarPositive_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> When your villagers' needs are met, Harmony is fostered. Each unique service building adds 2 to Global Resolve.
Relic_HarpyBattleground_T1_Desc: A group of fallen Harpy scientists... The sight causes unrest amongst the Harpy population.
Relic_HumanBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Human explorers. They were probably looking for a place to settle, far from the Queen's watchful eyes... The sight causes uneasiness amongst the Human population.
Relic_InfectedMole_Desc: One of the mythical guardians of the forest - still alive, but plagued by a mysterious disease. The Blightrot has taken over his mind, causing an unstoppable rage. You can try to heal him... or whisper prayers to its new masters.
Relic_InfectedTree_Desc: The once mighty tree has been deformed by the Blightrot living in its root system. The Blightrot poisons the tree's tissues, leading to its long-lasting degradation.
Relic_Kelpie_Desc: A legendary, shape-shifting aquatic spirit that lurks near water and mesmerizes travelers. It is said that whoever acquires the kelpie's bridle will be able to control it.
Relic_LeakingCauldron_Desc: An old, broken piece of Rainpunk technology. It's contaminating the soil around it.
Relic_LightningCatcher_Desc: A weird contraption that attracts lightning. Its proximity to the settlement might have grave consequences.
Relic_LizardBattleground_Desc: A group of fallen Lizard hunters... The sight causes unrest amongst the Lizard population.
Relic_MerchantShipWreck_Desc: How powerful must the storm surge have been to carry this shattered wreck all the way here? Perhaps in the distant past, there was a sea here? It looks as if it’s been lying here for centuries. Strange voices can be heard coming from below deck...
Relic_Mistworm_T1_Desc: A small, yet dangerous creature. It normally lives underground or hides in the mist, but this one seems to be more courageous than its kin.
Relic_Mole_Desc: A wild beast that usually lives underground. It was forced to the surface for some reason.
Relic_Monolith_Desc: A mystical stone monument. Unknown runes are carved all over its surface.
Relic_NoxiousMachinery_Desc: A damaged and abandoned rainpunk contraption. The area was probably deserted because of a significant explosion risk. The machine's valves emit a distinct Blightrot odor.
Relic_PetrifiedTree_T1_Desc: A strange tree that’s been turned to stone by the rain. It's radiating its sickness to the other trees around it.
Relic_RainpunkDrill_Desc: One of the Brass Order's curious little inventions. It appears to be broken.
Relic_RainpunkFactory_Desc: An old, abandoned piece of advanced Rainpunk technology. It seems extremely unstable - but maybe it can be rebuilt...
Relic_RainTotem_Desc: A totem built by the Fishmen. It seems to have affected the weather, making the rain heavier.
Relic_RewardChest_Desc: An abandoned cache of goods. This could be a lost shipment - or something much more valuable.
Relic_ScorpionReconstructed_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> Legend has it that they once inhabited the top of the mountain on which the Smoldering City now stands. The Queen banished them, but it is said that some of them still hibernate somewhere on the outskirts of the kingdom.
Relic_ScorpionStage1_Desc: Royal archaeologists are certain that a phenomenal discovery is hidden here. The Queen offers a generous reward for unearthing this ancient skeleton. This event is multi-stage and includes excavation, conservation, and reconstruction of the skeleton.
Relic_ScorpionStage2_Desc: After successfully excavating most of the ancient bones, they now need to be carefully conserved before proceeding to the reconstruction stage. However, the creature has not yet been identified.
Relic_ScorpionStage3_Desc: Archaeologists are ready to begin the final stage - reconstruction. A mythical creature is finally being unearthed. Huge bones are put together, revealing the full form of the monster that once inhabited this land.
Relic_SealedTombT2_Desc: An open entrance to an ancient dungeon. Strange sounds can be heard coming from inside.
Relic_SnakeReconstructed_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> This beast's anatomy is suited to both land and water, making it a deadly hunter of caravans and lost settlers. For some reason, its remains bear traces of Blightrot. Could it have brought this plague to the surface from the depths of the ocean?
Relic_SpiderReconstructed_Desc: <color=#D6E54A>Harmony.</color> Once faithful servants of the Sealed Ones, these creatures have been imprisoned underground with their masters. Yet miners still whisper of giant spiders emerging from deep caves to prey on the unwary. Only one thing is said to frighten them - the Holy Flame.
Relic_Stag_BeforeRunning_Desc: A patron of the spirit world. Once discovered, it flees to a nearby Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) or Forbidden Glade (<sprite name="forbidden">). It is said that a special treasure awaits the one who captures it.
Relic_Stormbird_Desc: A never-before encountered Stormbird subspecies. She is fiercely guarding her nest. The clouds around the settlement have begun to darken...
Relic_Stormforge_Desc: This small ancient cornerstone forge seems to have been twisted by some malevolent force, now serving a much darker purpose.
Relic_Temple_Desc: Who would worship the sun in a world with so little sunlight?
Relic_Termite_Desc: An aggressive, parasitic species, able to eat and digest even the hardest materials.
Relic_TotemOfDenial_Desc: A religious structure built by the Fishmen. It interferes with the Hearth in the center of the settlement.
Relic_ToxicSlug_Desc: A bizarre creature that dwells deep underground, in vast networks of water-filled caverns. On rare occasions, it finds its way to the surface, lurking in small reservoirs and preying on unsuspecting fishermen.
Relic_TradersCemetery_Desc: A cemetery full of traders killed by desperate viceroys. What drove them to commit such heinous crimes? Was it out of greed, or necessity?
Relic_WarBeastCage_Desc: A destroyed royal guard camp. It looks as if one of their warbeasts got out and razed the entire encampment to the ground. The beast, usually obedient to its masters, must have been provoked by something.
Relic_Wildfire_Desc: A wildfire spirit. It will wreak havoc on the settlement if it's not contained.
ReputationPenaltyRate_HearthEffect_Human: Human firekeepers create a special link with the Citadel. Impatience grows {0} slower.
ResolveEffect_AgriculturePenalty_Descrip: New farming methods are very effective, but cause a lot of pollution.
ResolveEffect_AncientArtifact_Descriptio: A strange device left behind by the Great Civilization. When soaked in rainwater, it radiates warm light and brings encouragement to those around it.
ResolveEffect_AnyHousingEffect_Descripti: Most species require at least basic shelter from the constant rainfall and gusting winds.
ResolveEffect_BatFactionSupport_Descript: Bats have always been wary and somewhat hostile, but you've proven yourself worthy of their trust.
ResolveEffect_BatHousingEffect_Desc: Bats prefer to live in spacious and dark homes. Bat Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_BatsDedication_Desc: Bats take pride in surviving what breaks other species.
ResolveEffect_BattlegroundPenalty_Desc: Seeing their fallen kin has taken its toll on the villagers.
ResolveEffect_BeaverHousingEffect_Descri: Beavers prefer to live in cozy, wooden homes. Beaver Houses are required to fulfill this need.
ResolveEffect_BeaverResolveWine_Desc: The settlement specializes in wine production, and Beavers love that.
ResolveEffect_BeaversFactionSupport_Desc: Ever since the Great Civil War, all species have been locked in a constant struggle to gain the Queen's favor. The Beaver clan remembers your help.
